description: Mark a task done. Sets taskStatus=done + doneAt and appends `outcome` to the task body as an Outcome section. The result carries a one-line `reminder` that the rest of the graph is not updated automatically.

id.description: Id of the task to mark done.

outcome.description: A short account of what was done — appended to the task body as an Outcome section.

name: complete_task
title: Complete a task
